_doc: Declares which .claude/ files are shared (symlinked to ai-resources) vs local (template-owned copies). The auto-sync hook reads this manifest. Files not listed here are ignored by auto-sync.
_skills_doc: Agent skills are opt-in: only names listed under skills.shared are symlinked from ai-resources/.agents/skills/. reorient is one of the five components of the Work Loop v2 capability — the sweep symlinks /work-loop-v2 into every project, and without reorient a compacted Codex session cannot re-establish the active task from disk. Removing it here leaves projects INCOMPLETE at work-loop-capability.sh.
